# Mantex

> Mantex is a WordPress-powered platform providing user authentication and account management services.

Mantex operates as a WordPress-based service with a focus on secure user access and account management. The platform provides essential authentication infrastructure for user login and password management.

## Key Topics

- WordPress
- User Authentication
- Login
- Account Management
- Password Reset
- User Access

## User Authentication & Access

- [Log In](https://mantex.co.uk/wp-login.php): WordPress login page for Mantex user authentication and account access
